details.description: VIP Hair Colour Shampoo in black for hair, moustache, beard and body hair. 100% grey coverage, ammonia-free. Pack of 5 sachets of 20ml.
details.usageInstructions: Apply on wet hair, lather, leave for 5 to 10 minutes and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.
